description: Limn, a UI toolkit for desktop Java: the two programs it ships, runnable by name. `jbang demo@limn-toolkit/limn-toolkit` opens the kitchen sink and `jbang theme-editor@limn-toolkit/limn-toolkit` the theme editor; on macOS put --java-options=-XstartOnFirstThread before the alias. Each resolves the newest release from Maven Central — RELEASE rather than a number, so a release never has to edit this file — and its POM selects the native libraries of the machine it runs on, so only that platform's are downloaded.

demo.description: The kitchen sink: every widget, the charts, the media player and the 3D viewport in one window. macOS: jbang --java-options=-XstartOnFirstThread demo@limn-toolkit/limn-toolkit

theme-editor.description: The screen that authors a Theme, with every fallback face and the fonts of this machine in its picker. macOS: jbang --java-options=-XstartOnFirstThread theme-editor@limn-toolkit/limn-toolkit
